name: pwr_currentconsumption_stop
description: PWR_CurrentConsumption in Stop mode (STOP_MODE, the readme's second line). After B1 (held from 0.5 to 1.2 s) the RTC's wake-up timer is set on LSI and the part enters Stop with the low-power regulator and the flash powered down: HSE and the PLL stop, SYSCLK falls back to HSI (CFGR 0x1400: SW and SWS HSI, APB1 over 4), LD2 stays dark. 0xA000 periods of LSI/16 later (20.48 s at the 32 kHz LSI) the wake-up interrupt ends Stop, the callback sets uwCounter to 1, SYSCLK is the PLL again (CFGR 0x140A) and LD2 toggles every 100 ms.
